name: Boku ga High Spec Danshi ni Naretara Tsukiatte Kuremasuka
original_name: 僕がハイスペ男子になれたら付き合ってくれますか
source:
After first entering high school, you meet Haisupei Manabu.
He suddenly asks you out, vowing to become a guy worth dating.
Will three years of high school be enough for him to reach his goal?!
